data.body:
AC5 — epic e369 close disposition (recorded per acceptance criteria):

Epic e369 ("Jira Server / Data Center support via a Jira-family seam") is currently
in_progress and owned by a parallel live session. It has NOT been closed via the old
degraded-open bug screen — there is no tainted/unsigned close of e369 to reconcile.

The gate fix delivered by this ticket is merged and reachable from origin/main
(max_tokens re-clamp commit e49e7a418a confirmed as ancestor of origin/main). With that
fix, the completion-verifier's epic-close bug screen now REFUSES the close on
LLMUnavailableError (nonzero exit, ticket stays in_progress, no signature) instead of
silently degrading open; --force-close remains the explicit escape hatch. Therefore when
e369 is eventually closed, its bug screen will be correctly gated by this fix.

Disposition: no re-verification of a prior e369 close is needed (none occurred); the gate
is now in place for its future close. Closing 1019 as preexisting.
